comment_regular: Find EntryData for an exact TESForm in ExtraContainerChanges. Native ABI is three stack arguments and retn 0x0C. The middle Boolean is not read; callers conventionally pass true. If referenceFormIDOrZero is nonzero, require an extend-data list whose ExtraReferencePointer target has that form ID; otherwise return the form entry directly.
